definitions.explanation: The end or tip of a finger. Used both literally (physical fingertip) and in expressions describing delicate actions, sensations, or fine motor skills.

examples.japanese: {指先|ゆびさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧。
{指先|ゆびさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{触|ふ}れた→触れる：01984_fureru⟧。
examples.english: I touched it lightly with my fingertip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{指先|ゆびさき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{繊細|せんさい}→繊細：07607_sensai⟧な⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the delicate works created by the craftsman's fingertips.

notes:
USAGE:
{指先|ゆびさき} is a compound of ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ (finger) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (tip). It often appears in descriptions of delicate work, physical sensations, or skillful handling. In Japanese, {指先|ゆびさき} can also refer to toe tips, though this usage is less common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指先|ゆびさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧: to be dexterous
- {指先|ゆびさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧: to touch with one's fingertips
- {指先|ゆびさき}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|い}き{届|とど}く→行き届く：30420_ikitodoku⟧: to pay attention to every detail
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{指先|ゆびさき}: cold fingertips
